O foco será a construção de ecossistemas inteligentes, indo além de modelos isolados para criar arquiteturas de agentes capazes de resolver demandas complexas de negócio e backoffice. O DESAFIO:  Orquestração e Agentes:  Projetar sistemas multiagentes utilizando LangGraph  ou Agent Squad  para decompor tarefas complexas em workflows automatizados. Observabilidade e Tracing (Prioridade):  Implementar o rastreamento completo da \"cadeia de pensamento\" (Chain of Thought) e execução dos agentes. Monitoramento de Performance:  Utilizar ferramentas como Langfuse  ou LangSmith  para monitorar latência, consumo de tokens e qualidade das respostas em tempo real. Desenvolvimento de Ferramentas:  Criar conexões seguras entre LLMs e APIs externas via Model Context Protocol (MCP) , garantindo o isolamento e a segurança dos dados. Arquitetura RAG:  Otimizar pipelines de recuperação de informação utilizando Vector Stores  (Pinecone  ou MongoDB ) para mitigar alucinações e aumentar a precisão contextual. Infraestrutura Cloud:  Gerenciar deploys em ambientes AWS  ou Azure  e integrar modelos via AWS Bedrock  ou Azure OpenAI Service , priorizando arquiteturas Serverless e Event-Driven. AI Guardrails:  Implementar camadas de filtragem e validação de prompts/outputs para evitar injeções de código ou desvios éticos. Avaliação Sistemática:  Desenvolver frameworks de testes (Evals) para validar a eficácia de novas funcionalidades antes do deploy em produção. Eficiência de Custos:  Monitorar e otimizar o uso de modelos (Model Routing) para equilibrar performance e custo operacional.  O QUE VOCÊ PRECISA:  Linguagens:  Domínio avançado de Python  e Java  para automação de workflows e integraçoes e desenvolvimento de IA. DevOps/MLOps:  Experiência com Docker , Containerization  e práticas de CI/CD para modelos de linguagem. Educação:  Graduação em Engenharia de Computação ou áreas correlatas.  VOCÊ VAI BRILHAR AINDA MAIS SE TIVER:  Experiência prévia na construção de assistentes inteligentes escaláveis (ex: via WhatsApp) e pesquisa em Explainable AI (XAI) . Experiência com práticas de CI/CD aplicadas a modelos, serviços de inferência ou pipelines analíticos. Conhecimento em bancos de dados, SQL, ambientes analíticos e integração com plataformas de dados. Capacidade de traduzir necessidades de Data Science e negócio em soluções técnicas reutilizáveis, escaláveis e sustentáveis. Experiência com monitoramento, logs, métricas, rastreabilidade e troubleshooting de aplicações, pipelines ou modelos em produção. Experiência em ambientes regulados, especialmente mercado financeiro, meios de pagamento, bancos digitais, fintechs, crédito, risco, fraude, adquirência ou CRM. Conhecimento em Kafka, arquiteturas orientadas a eventos e processamento distribuído. Experiência com práticas de segurança em cloud, IAM, secrets management, criptografia, segregação de ambientes e proteção de dados sensíveis. Familiaridade com LGPD, princípios de Responsible AI e governança de dados.

We are looking for a strategic and creative Senior Writer to lead content development, drive show performance, and manage a team of writers across multiple audio series. Role Overview  As a Senior Writer, you will be the end-to-end owner of multiple shows, responsible for their creative direction, content quality, and audience performance. You will lead a team of Junior Writers, oversee localization and adaptation workflows, and ensure that each show delivers strong engagement and retention. This role requires a blend of storytelling expertise, analytical thinking, and leadership to continuously optimize content from a user-first perspective. Key Responsibilities  1. Show Ownership & Editorial Strategy  Own multiple shows end-to-end, from pre-editorial planning to post-release optimization. Define show-level creative direction, narrative arcs, and long-term storytelling strategy. Review and approve concept notes, localization approaches, and adaptation frameworks. Ensure consistency in tone, character development, and narrative quality across episodes and seasons.  2. Content Development & Adaptation Oversight  Oversee script adaptation and localization workflows executed by Junior Writers. Ensure all scripts meet editorial standards, cultural relevance, and storytelling depth. Guide the use of GenAI tools for structured, high-quality script adaptation. Provide detailed feedback and direction to refine scripts before production.  3. Team Management & Leadership  Manage and mentor a team of Junior Writers, each assigned to individual shows. Review outputs, provide constructive feedback, and ensure consistent quality across the team. Drive accountability, productivity, and skill development within the team. Foster a strong creative culture focused on storytelling excellence and user impact.  4. Performance Monitoring & Optimization  Track and analyze show performance using key metrics such as user retention, listen duration, and conversion. Identify underperforming episodes, story arcs, or shows and implement data-driven improvements. Plan and execute show reworks based on audience behavior and feedback. Continuously optimize content to maximize engagement and platform growth.  5. Production Collaboration & Quality Control  Provide feedback on voice-over, production quality, and final audio output. Ensure alignment between scripts and produced audio content. Collaborate with production, QC, and creative teams to maintain high-quality output.  6. User-Centric Content Improvement  Analyze user feedback, comments, and listening patterns to refine storytelling approaches. Apply a strong user-first lens to identify gaps and solve content-related challenges. Ensure content resonates with target audiences and drives long-term engagement.  7. title: Senior Machine Learning Engineer
description:

We are a Silicon Valley based product company building a next‑generation AI‑native B2B platform for hospitality. We’re looking for a Senior Machine Learning Engineer  who is excited about the craft of machine learning—especially the mathematical and statistical foundations  behind models—and who can turn that depth into solutions that scale in real-world use. If you’re someone who enjoys choosing the right model for the problem, validating it rigorously, and improving it through iteration, you’ll feel at home here. This is an opportunity for an engineer who wants to grow into a future architect , help define large-scale backend systems, and become a true technical champion  within the team. If you are passionate about modern backend engineering, clean architecture, and scalable distributed systems, you’ll love working with us. What you’ll do  Design, train, and improve statistical and machine learning models  for real product use cases. Apply strong fundamentals in probability, statistics, and modeling  to make sound decisions on approach and evaluation. Build scalable ML solutions  that can be used reliably in production environments. Develop capabilities to support agent-like experiences  within our platform (e.g., intelligent workflows, tool-using behaviors, retrieval patterns, guardrails). Define and monitor meaningful model metrics, run error analysis, and iterate based on results.  What we’re looking for  We’re intentionally not treating this as a checklist. If you’re strong in the fundamentals and have built real ML systems, we’d love to hear from you. You’ll be successful  in this role if you have : Strong knowledge across a broad range of machine learning algorithms  (supervised/unsupervised methods, ensembles, linear models, tree-based methods, deep learning basics) and the judgment to choose appropriately. Solid grounding in statistics and mathematical reasoning  (e.g., bias/variance tradeoffs, uncertainty, evaluation design). Experience building ML solutions in practice: data understanding, feature design, training, evaluation, and iteration. Strong Python skills and the ability to write clear, maintainable code. Familiarity with standard ML tooling (e.g., scikit-learn, PyTorch/TensorFlow).  Nice to have (not required) Experience with NLP and/or LLMs  (helpful, but not a core requirement). Exposure to ML-related capabilities on AWS , such as training/inference workflows or managed ML services (e.g., SageMaker), and working with storage/data access patterns commonly used for ML. Experience implementing or integrating vector search / embedding-based retrieval .  Why Join Us  You will work in a modern, AI-native engineering culture building applied machine learning systems that ship. You’ll have the opportunity to design mathematically grounded models, turn them into scalable product capabilities, and help define how intelligent agents live inside our platform. This role is ideal for someone who loves ML fundamentals, enjoys solving real problems end-to-end, and wants to grow into a senior technical leader shaping our ML direction. Equal Opportunity  Directful is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome candidates of all backgrounds and do not discriminate on the basis of any protected characteristic.

This role involves creating a seamless and efficient data ingestion, processing, and delivery system, integrating data and high-performance querying. Designing and building out a core data layer to power all CBS Sports Digital products, ingesting, processing, and storing data from hundreds of sources over different transports and data stores. Defining a distributed tracing system for web services and data observability within a GraphQL ecosystem. Containerizing core systems to reduce the overhead of infrastructure management. Migration of legacy applications and services to our core data ingestion and GraphQL workflows. Hands-on experience working in a distributed cloud-based environment with high transaction volumes, using a variety of connected services. Are you obsessive about catching what others miss? Do you notice inconsistencies without being told where to look? Do you get satisfaction from identifying errors before they become problems? Final question:  when faced with a challenge, do you get excited or run away? If that sounds like you, you may be the perfect fit for our Paid Ads QA  role. At Crisp, we're on a mission to help 10,000 law firms each grow their revenue by $10,000,000 over the next 10 years, creating a $10 billion impact in the legal industry. Our Paid Ads team is responsible for executing paid media campaigns that power our law firm clients’ brand awareness and growth across major digital platforms. These campaigns are deployed across hundreds of client accounts and multiple platforms simultaneously. This role exists to ensure those campaigns are executed accurately, consistently, and in alignment with internal standards and client intent. This is a non-client-facing, audit-focused role that requires extreme attention to detail, strong system thinking, and the discipline to identify and document discrepancies with zero tolerance for preventable error. However, it is not a “task-ing” role, or a role where you’ll be constantly told what to do - you’ll be expected to self-sufficiently spot and correct errors, but most importantly, get ahead of them before even happening, including improving existing systems. ** IMPORTANT: TO APPLY **  You will be evaluated and vetted based on your ability to follow instructions:  Follow this Willo link (recorded interview platform), and answer the few questions on there, first.Then reply to the ad, stating you’ve completed the Willo, and we will be in touch.  Key Responsibilities Include:  Campaign Audit & Validation  Audit paid advertising campaigns across Meta, Google Ads, LinkedIn, TikTok, streaming platforms, and others Verify that the correct creative assets, ad copy, and campaign structures are deployed on the correct client accounts Ensure campaigns align with intended funnel stages and approved execution parameters  Execution Accuracy & Cross-Account Integrity  Identify discrepancies such as: Incorrect assets deployed to the wrong client Mismatched ad copy or campaign configurations Inconsistent implementation across platforms Ensure campaign execution matches internal direction and client-specific setup  Budget & Pacing Verification  Audit campaign budgets to ensure alignment with approved allocations Identify risks of underdelivery or overspend Validate that budget adjustments and reallocations are executed correctly  Tracking, Links & Technical QA  Verify accuracy and functionality of: URLs and landing pages UTM execution against: Internal strategy direction Client Success Manager requests Campaign updates or pivots Ensure requested changes are implemented accurately and completely  Audit Documentation & Communication  Document audit findings clearly, with supporting context and evidence Categorize issues based on severity (e.g., minor discrepancy vs. critical error) Communicate findings in a structured format that enables efficient resolution  Audit Operations (Evolving Scope)  This role may operate across a range of audit models depending on business needs, including: Audit Cadence: Pre-launch validation Post-launch verification Ongoing daily, weekly, or periodic audits  Audit Coverage: Full account audits Targeted sampling across accounts  Audit Depth: Surface-level validation (assets, placements, links) Deeper audits (budget pacing, tracking, structural accuracy)  Ownership Scope: Identifying and flagging discrepancies Recommending corrective actions Supporting enforcement of quality standards  Our requirements are pretty straightforward. To qualify you must:  Be highly detail-oriented — you catch inconsistencies others miss Think in structured processes, checklists, and systems Be proactive in identifying issues and asking clarifying questions Be comfortable operating with incomplete information and making sound judgments Have strong written communication skills Be tech-savvy and able to learn new platforms quickly Be comfortable working in a fast-paced, high-volume environment  Preferred Experience:  Experience auditing or QA-ing digital campaigns (launches, changes, tracking) Familiarity with UTM structures, tracking links, and link verification Experience working with dashboards or reporting tools Experience using project management or task tracking tools (Asana, Monday, etc.)  Nice to Have:  Salesforce or CRM familiarity Experience with Supermetrics or similar data connectors Familiarity with Google Looker Studio or similar dashboards Experience documenting processes or building SOPs Experience in a fast-paced, multi-client environment  Platform Exposure (Preferred, Not Required):  Meta Ads Manager Google Ads Google Tag Manager (GTM) TikTok Ads LinkedIn Ads TradeDesk  Why Our Work Matters:  Lawyers go to law school to learn how to practice law, but law school doesn’t teach them how to run a business. In a world where the best cases often go to the best marketers, legal expertise alone isn’t enough. That’s where Crisp comes in. We partner with committed, growth-minded law firms that care deeply about their teams, clients, and communities. Often, it’s a David vs. Goliath scenario, where the most dedicated attorneys lack the resources of their larger competitors. Our work levels the playing field by giving law firms access to world-class marketing execution that helps them stand out, build authority, and grow sustainably. About Crisp:   Crisp has been recognized on the Inc. 5000 (Fastest Growing Private Companies in the U.S. – 2024, 2022, 2021, 2020, 2019, 2018, 2017), as well as Atlanta's Top 100 Fastest Growing Private Companies (2025, 2024, 2023, 2022, 2021, 2020, 2019, 2018, 2017, 2016) and Atlanta's Best Places to Work (2024, 2023, 2022). Crisp ( is the nation’s fastest-growing law firm growth company. We’ve helped thousands of attorneys — from solo and small firms to large practices — build their brand, differentiate themselves from competitors, attract better cases, and earn millions in new revenue. Crisp has been featured in Forbes, Inc., Avvo, ABA Journal, The Trial Lawyer, Huffington Post, and The Wall Street Journal. This is a role for someone who takes pride in enforcing standards, identifying errors, and ensuring systems operate correctly. ** IMPORTANT: TO APPLY **  You will be evaluated and vetted based on your ability to follow instructions:  Follow this Willo link (recorded interview platform), and answer the few questions on there, first.Then reply to the ad, stating you’ve completed the Willo, and we will be in touch.

description:

About us:  Toluna is the global research and insights leader that enables businesses to make smarter, data-driven decisions—faster. For 26 years, we have partnered with the world’s leading brands, delivering transformative impact through our advanced technology platform, comprehensive solution portfolio, expansive global first-party panel, and world-class team of leading research experts. Since 2019, we’ve made significant investments in artificial intelligence to enhance automation, accelerate insight delivery, and unlock deeper understanding at scale. With 40+ offices worldwide, Toluna operates in 70+ countries, redefining the future of insights. Learn  Introduction:  We are seeking a Data Scientist to join our global advanced analytics team. In this role, you’ll lead the design and execution of advanced analytical solutions that inform strategic decision-making for our clients. You’ll leverage your deep technical expertise and market research experience to drive innovation, mentor junior analysts, and deliver impactful, data-driven recommendations. This is an exciting opportunity for a passionate analytics professional who thrives at the intersection of data science, business strategy, and storytelling, with growing expectations around applied AI and intelligent automation. Responsibilities:  Lead the design and implementation of advanced analytical frameworks to address complex business challenges across a variety of industries. Partner with internal teams and clients to translate business objectives into analytical solutions, ensuring alignment with strategic priorities. Design, build, and maintain practical analytics-facing AI-enabled solutions such as analytical agents, automated insights generation, or decision support tools using large language models or similar technologies. Evaluate where AI can responsibly augment analytical work, including data preparation, model development, quality checks, insight synthesis, and delivery, while maintaining methodological rigor. Partner with engineering, analytics, or product teams to operationalize AI-driven analytics in repeatable and scalable ways. Deliver high-impact storytelling and visualization, distilling complex analyses into clear narratives that influence senior stakeholders. Act as a trusted consultant, providing analytic guidance and thought leadership on market research methodologies, data interpretation, and advanced modeling. Mentor and support junior analysts, reviewing outputs, sharing best practices, and fostering a culture of learning and quality. Champion automation, standardization, and innovation, identifying opportunities to optimize workflows and analytical efficiency. Stay current on emerging tools, data science techniques, and market trends to continuously enhance Toluna’s analytics capabilities.  Your profile:  5+ years of professional experience in data analytics, advanced analytics, or market research roles. Bachelor’s or master's degree in data science, statistics, economics, computer science, or a related field. Advanced proficiency in Python, R, SQL, SPSS and/or Sawtooth Strong command of statistical modeling, segmentation, predictive analytics, and experimental design. Proven ability to lead analytical projects from scoping to delivery, including stakeholder management and quality assurance. Excellent communication and storytelling skills, able to translate complex data findings into business implications. Hands-on experience applying AI or machine learning in real-world analytics contexts, beyond academic or purely experimental work. Familiarity with large language models and their practical use in analytics workflows, such as building or supervising AI agents, prompt-driven analysis, or automated insight generation. Strong judgment around model quality, bias, explainability, and appropriate use of AI in client-facing analytical work. description:

The Challenge  Every year, the healthcare industry loses billions due to billing failures. We are building the missing link that closes this gap with AI. We are growing fast, with real operations, active customers, and new partners in the pipeline. We are looking for a builder who wants to help turn our current product into a platform with global scale. Why This Role Might Be for You  Here, autonomy, ownership, and initiative are part of the daily routine. We are not looking for someone who already knows everything. Not knowing is part of the process. What matters to us is investigative curiosity, strong execution, and a genuine desire to learn. You will work across both execution and strategy: from writing code to helping shape product and technical decisions. This is a role for someone who can propose new models, spot revenue opportunities, and also dig into data manually when needed to make sure the solution is truly accurate. What We’re Looking For  Investigative curiosity: You want to understand complex medical billing rules and are motivated to master a difficult domain. Healthcare experience is not required. Bias for action: You move fast, take initiative, and understand that speed matters in an early-stage company. Hands-on coding ability: Solid practical experience with Python or Go, plus experience working with LLM APIs such as OpenAI, Anthropic, or AWS Bedrock. Builder mindset: You enjoy creating robust systems from scratch and care deeply about precision, reliability, and business impact.  What We Offer  Early-stage impact: Be one of the early team members in a fast-growing company and help shape both the architecture and the culture. High-level technical challenge: Work on real business problems using modern generative AI. Strong team: Work with ambitious, high-performing people who care about building something meaningful. Remote flexibility: 100% remote work, open to candidates based in Brazil. Long-term upside: Potential equity participation for people who help build the business with us. Legacy: Your work will leave a real mark on the product, the codebase, and the company’s story.

Como consultor Funcional, você atuará como Key User funcional  especializado em Salesforce Sales Cloud e Service Cloud, sendo a ponte entre o time comercial (vendas e atendimento) e as áreas técnicas de TI. Para esta vaga, é essencial:  Experiência prática comprovada em Salesforce Sales Cloud  e Service Cloud  (mínimo 2 anos atuando como key user, analista funcional ou consultor). Conhecimento sólido de processos de vendas , CRM  e atendimento ao cliente  (ex.: ciclo de leads, oportunidades, casos, SLAs). Capacidade de traduzir necessidades de negócio em requisitos funcionais claros e testáveis. Boa comunicação verbal e escrita para interagir com usuários negócio e times técnicos. Visão de processo e pensamento analítico para identificar melhorias e resolver problemas. Demonstrar conhecimento em ferramentas de automação (Flow, Process Builder) ou integrações (API, middleware). Já tiver atuado em projetos de implantação ou migração de CRM. Apresentar familiaridade com métricas comerciais (funnel de vendas, tempo médio de resposta, NPS, etc.) e capacidade de criar KPIs no Salesforce. Ter experiência em setores regulados (financeiro, utilities, telecom) que exigem governança e rastreabilidade. Vaga:  Enfermeiro(a) — Programa Enfermeiro sem Fronteiras Salário:  R$14.500,00 (2.500 euros — inicial) + benefícios   Localidade:  Alemanha (Berlim, Munique ou outras cidades com demanda hospitalar — a definir conforme colocação)  Programa:  Enfermeiro sem Fronteiras, da Sprache&Wissen  Como funciona?  Você participa de um processo seletivo e, se aprovado(a), se inscreve para estudar alemão por até 2 anos na maior escola online de alemão da América Latina, até atingir o nível B2 (final do intermediário). Antes de iniciar seus estudos, você recebe um contrato com garantia de emprego na Alemanha, com cláusulas específicas e seguras — desde que cumpra os requisitos do programa. Se a S&W não conseguir sua colocação após você atingir o B2, o valor investido é devolvido integralmente. Durante todo o período de estudo, você conta com mentoria direcionada da Sprache&Wissen.  Quem é a Sprache&Wissen?  A Sprache&Wissen (S&W) é uma empresa brasileira fundada por dois irmãos mineiros: um administrador formado pelo CEFET-MG e uma professora de alemão doutora pela UFMG. O grupo educacional administra as marcas Clube de Alemão, Punkify e Vale-idiomas. A S&W é a maior escola online de alemão da América Latina, com a meta de capacitar 100 mil brasileiros até 2030 nos idiomas alemão e inglês. Possui mais de 500 mil seguidores nas redes sociais e satisfação de 98,9%.  Principais atividades (na Alemanha):  Cuidado direto ao paciente em ambiente hospitalar ou clínico Administração de medicamentos e acompanhamento de tratamentos Documentação clínica e comunicação com equipe multidisciplinar em alemão Participação em plantões conforme escala do empregador  Requisitos:  Diploma de Enfermagem (bacharelado) reconhecido no Brasil Idade máxima de 36 anos (requisito do programa de visto alemão) Disponibilidade para estudar alemão por até 2 anos até o nível B2, com flexibilidade de horários Comprometimento com a carga horária do curso e as etapas do programa Documentação em dia para solicitação de visto (passaporte válido ou possibilidade de emitir)  Diferenciais:  Conhecimento prévio de alemão (qualquer nível) Experiência em UTI, emergência ou centro cirúrgico Experiência internacional ou intercâmbio Inglês intermediário ou avançado  Sobre o período de estudos (home office):  O curso de alemão é 100% online — você estuda do Brasil enquanto se prepara Mentoria gratuita em grupo durante toda a jornada até o B2 Flexibilidade para conciliar com seu emprego atual  Etapas do processo:  Inscrição e triagem inicial Entrevista com o time da S&W Aprovação de ficha e documentações Assinatura do contrato com garantia de emprego Matrícula no curso de alemão (até o nível B2) Match com recrutador alemão Colocação profissional na Alemanha

title: Post Producer
description:
Empresa está contratando Post Producer em campinas. Veja detalhes e envie seu currículo.

Post Producer  Location:  Remote Position Type:  Contract Company:  Pocket FM About Us  At Pocket FM, our mission is to deliver immersive storytelling experiences to a global audience. With a global audience of over 200 million listeners, we are redefining entertainment through episodic audio storytelling across diverse genres. We are seeking a highly organized and creative Creative Producer  to manage and oversee the end-to-end production of high-quality audio content. Role Overview  As a Creative Producer , you will play a key role in managing the end-to-end production process of audio content across various formats on Pocket FM. You will collaborate closely with writers, voice artists, creators, and production teams to ensure timely delivery of high-quality episodes. The role requires strong operational management, creative oversight, and the ability to coordinate across multiple stakeholders to deliver compelling audio experiences for our listeners. Key Responsibilities  1. Post Production Operations Management   Oversee day-to-day post-production operations for ongoing audio shows and promotional adds, ensuring smooth workflows from raw audio to final delivery. Manage editing, sound design, mixing, and mastering pipelines to meet release schedules. 2. Post Production Team Coordination   Work closely with editors, sound designers, mixing engineers, and external post-production vendors to deliver high-quality audio content. Ensure clear briefs, efficient collaboration, and consistency across outputs. 3. Production Planning & Pipeline Management   Collaborate with content and production teams to plan post-production schedules, track weekly deliverables, and ensure timely completion of all episodes. Proactively identify and resolve bottlenecks in the pipeline. 4. Stakeholder Collaboration   Coordinate with cross-functional teams including Content, Marketing, Product, and Quality Control to align on timelines, creative requirements, and delivery standards. 5. Audio Quality & Finishing Oversight   Own the final quality of all audio outputs, including editing precision, sound design, mixing balance, mastering levels, and overall listening experience. Ensure all content meets defined technical and creative benchmarks before release. 6. Vendor & Partner Management   Build and manage a network of external studios, freelancers, and post-production partners to support scalable content production. Ensure quality, consistency, and timely delivery across partners. 7. Feedback Integration & Continuous Improvement   Monitor listener feedback and internal QC inputs to identify issues related to audio clarity, pacing, sound design, or technical quality. Drive improvements across post-production processes. 8. Process & Workflow Optimization   Continuously enhance post-production workflows, tools, and standards to improve efficiency, scalability, and output quality. Document best practices, templates, and guidelines for consistent execution. 9. Volume & Deadline Management   Manage high-volume content pipelines across multiple shows, ensuring all deadlines are met without compromising on audio quality or production standards. 10. Quality Control Training & Creative Alignment  Continuously train and support QC team members responsible for assigned shows to ensure strong alignment on creative direction, audio quality standards, storytelling expectations, and technical benchmarks. Work closely with QC specialists on a weekly basis to review content, calibrate feedback, identify recurring issues, and maintain consistency across shows and post-production outputs. 11. Internal Promotional Video Post-Production Leadership   Lead the internal post-production team for promotional video assets, aligning editors, sound designers, and mixers around consistent quality standards, sonic identity, creative style, and delivery expectations. Ensure all promotional videos maintain a cohesive audio language, polished sound design, and production value aligned with brand and marketing objectives. 12. AI-driven Innovations and tool adotion  Leverage AI-powered tools and emerging technologies across editing, sound design, voice processing, mixing, mastering, QC, and workflow automation to improve efficiency, scalability, and creative quality. Stay updated on evolving AI trends in post-production and evaluate new tools/workflows that enhance turnaround time, consistency, audio quality, and overall production effectiveness while maintaining strong creative and editorial standards. Qualifications  7+ years of experience in post-production, audio production, or media production, with a strong focus on editing, sound design, and final delivery workflows. Solid understanding of audio storytelling and hands-on experience across post-production stages, including editing, mixing, mastering, and finishing for podcasts or audiobooks. Proven experience working with post-production teams such as editors, sound designers, mixing engineers, or external production vendors. Strong project management and organizational skills, with the ability to manage multiple post-production pipelines and deadlines simultaneously. Effective stakeholder management and communication skills, with experience collaborating across content, production, and quality teams. Ability to operate in fast-paced, high-volume production environments while maintaining consistent quality standards. Self-driven with strong problem-solving capabilities and a proactive approach to identifying and resolving production challenges.

NLP or voice experience.  You've worked with speech recognition, intent extraction, text classification, or conversational AI. Bonus if it was in noisy, multilingual, or domain-specific environments. Full-stack ML instincts.  You can train a model, build the data pipeline, optimize inference, deploy it, and monitor it. You don't wait for a platform team — you are the platform team. Builder mentality.  You've worked in startups or fast-moving environments. You ship fast. You make decisions with 70% of the data. You'd rather build something imperfect today than plan something perfect for next quarter. Fluent English required. Spanish or Portuguese strongly preferred.  You'll work with mechanics, ops teams, and partners across three countries. RequirementsTimezone:  Must be available during US/LatAm business hours (UTC-3 to UTC-8). This is a real-time collaboration role, not async. Commitment:  This is a full-time, dedicated position. Your models get better not because of more compute, but because of more reality. And if you prove you can own this — you lead the team we build around it.

Key Responsibilities   ● Lead the design process from concept to completion, ensuring all deliverables meet  high-quality standards and align with client goals.  ● Collaborate with clients to understand their brand identity, target audience, and business objectives in order to create customized website designs that resonate with their audience.  ● Develop wireframes, prototypes, and mockups to effectively communicate design concepts and user interactions to support rapid exploration and iteration.  ● Create visually appealing graphics, icons, and other assets to enhance the overall aesthetic and user experience of websites, to meet BX Studio’s standards for originality, quality, and brand fit.  ● Stay updated on industry trends, best practices, emerging technologies, and AI-assisted design workflows to continually improve the quality and innovation of our web designs.  ● Mentor and provide guidance to junior designers, fostering their growth and development within the team.  ● Work closely with the development team to ensure seamless integration of design elements and functionality.  ● Conduct usability testing and gather feedback to iterate and refine designs for optimal user experience to identify patterns, summarize feedback, and support design improvements.  ● Collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure project timelines and milestones are met effectively to improve speed, quality, and delivery efficiency. Qualifications:   ● Bachelor's degree in Graphic Design, Web Design, or a related field.  ● Minimum of 5 years of experience in web design, with a strong portfolio showcasing a range of successful projects.  ● Proficiency in design tools such as Adobe Creative Suite (Photoshop, Illustrator, XD), Sketch, or Figma, with practical experience using AI-assisted design tools such as ChatGPT, Claude, Midjourney, Adobe Firefly, Figma AI, Relume, Framer AI, or similar tools.  ● Solid understanding of responsive design principles and best practices for web usability and accessibility, content hierarchy, and UX improvements.  ● Strong knowledge of HTML, CSS, and JavaScript/jQuery, with the ability to collaborate effectively with developers on both traditional and AI-enabled website experiences.  ● Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to present and explain design concepts to clients and team members.  ● Proven ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously in a fast-paced environment, while maintaining attention to detail and meeting deadlines to improve efficiency without compromising quality.  ● Experience with content management systems (CMS) such as Webflow, with familiarity in Webflow, and Framer is considered a strong plus.  ● A passion for creativity, innovation, and staying abreast of industry trends, emerging technologies, and responsible AI use in modern web design. Join our dynamic team and help us create exceptional web experiences that drive success for our clients! If you're passionate about design, technology, AI-assisted workflows, and making a real impact, we want to hear from you.

title: Founding Engineer (Path to CTO)
description:
Empresa está contratando Founding Engineer (Path to CTO) em campinas. Veja detalhes e envie seu currículo.

SOBRE A VAGA  A Hamurabi Apps está contratando uma pessoa engenheira, builder, intensa e extremamente dona pra ser nossa CTO fundadora. A vaga tem um arco claro. Nos primeiros 3-6 meses, você é, na prática, Founding Engineer: codando todos os dias, polindo os 5 produtos até estado lançável, construindo infra compartilhada e operando produto em produção. Conforme a receita aparece e o time cresce, você assume o papel pleno de CTO: contratação, arquitetura, mentoria, direção técnica, e cada vez menos código diário. Vaga founding, equity-only. Você trabalha direto com o Pablo (founder da Izzicupo Borges, que adquiriu a Hamurabi) e com o Founding Operator, que vamos trazer em paralelo. SNAPSHOT  • Localização: Remoto Brasil + workshops/sprints ocasionais em Uberlândia/MG (sede da Izzicupo Borges) • Modelo: equity-only no início, com gatilhos claros de receita destravando comp fixa (detalhe em POTENCIAL DE GANHO) • Equity: 15% founding-level (vesting 4 anos, cliff 1 ano, reverse vesting, bad leaver clauses padrão) • Bônus por milestone de produto: definidos caso a caso (ship de novo micro-app, atingir SLA-alvo, escalar 10x usuários) • Path to CTO consolidado: Cargo se consolida com 3+ engenheiros sob você e infra em produção com SLA • Perfil: full-stack sênior ou staff, AI-native, customer-obsessed, confortável codando legal-tech, dev-tools, cloud, ERP e agentes no mesmo mês O QUE FAZEMOS  A Hamurabi Apps é um estúdio de micro-apps. Nascemos como software house low-code/no-code (Bubble Silver Partner). Em 2025, fomos adquiridos pela Izzicupo Borges e estamos relançando a tese: portfólio focado de produtos com receita recorrente, todos construídos, operados e licenciados sob o mesmo teto, com infra compartilhada e distribuição cruzada. Cinco micro-apps medianos rendendo R$ 30k de MRR cada batem uma startup média lutando por PMF. Portfólio atual (5 produtos não lançados publicamente): • Análise de risco jurídico em contratos com NLP, pra escritórios e jurídicos in-house • Analytics de performance de engenharia com IA, pra times técnicos e CTOs • Plataforma de automação e infra cloud, pra times que orquestram deploy e workflows • ERPs sob medida pra PMEs (gestão financeira, fiscal, operacional) • Agente que constrói landing pages do zero a partir de prompt NOSSA MISSÃO  Provar que dá pra construir uma fábrica brasileira de software AI-native gerando milhões em ARR com time pequeno, intenso e dono. A maioria dos estúdios brasileiros nasce com cara de incubadora, escritório bonito, demo day e zero produto rodando. A Hamurabi nasce do oposto: produto primeiro, narrativa depois. COMO É O DIA A DIA  Você não vai herdar uma engenharia rodando, vai construí-la. Não tem head of eng, QA dedicado, DevOps. Tem o Pablo (founder, também codador), o Founding Operator (que vamos trazer em paralelo), 1 dev pleno e os 5 produtos com graus diferentes de maturidade. A pessoa certa abre issue do produto jurídico às 9h, faz code review do dev pleno às 11h, refatora o RAG do produto de analytics à tarde, sobe deploy do produto de cloud à noite, e no dia seguinte abre PR de uma abstração compartilhada que vai servir o próximo micro-app. NÃO APLIQUE SE VOCÊ:  • Espera receber arquitetura desenhada e sprint planejado. Aqui você É o arquiteto e o planner • Precisa de salário fixo grande. A base é zero no início. Dinheiro vem da equity, gatilhos e milestones • Não codifica em produção há mais de 6 meses. A vaga é hands-on do dia 1 • Tem ego de cargo. Você vai escrever código, fazer deploy, debugar produção, code review, JD, tudo, sozinho, no começo • Não usa IA pra programar (Cursor, Claude, MCP). Aqui IA escreve a maior parte do boilerplate • Tem medo de mexer em múltiplas linguagens/stacks ao mesmo tempo (TS, Python, infra, AI, frontend) • Precisa de processo todo desenhado e backlog todo grooming antes de começar • Não topa ambiente de altíssima exigência. Acompanhamos ship rate, uptime e qualidade semanalmente desde o dia 1 O QUE VOCÊ VAI FAZER  Construir e shippar (responsabilidade #1, sobretudo nos primeiros 3-6 meses): • Polir os 5 produtos do portfólio até estado lançável (UX, performance, billing, onboarding, observabilidade) • Codar diariamente em produção. Backend, frontend, infra, AI, integrações: você cobre tudo • Estabelecer infra compartilhada (billing, auth, observability, analytics) entre os 5 produtos • Subir o que quebrar, otimizar o que estiver lento, refatorar o que estiver podre Operar e escalar (escopo cresce a partir do mês 3): • Uptime, SLAs, segurança, custo de infra, CI/CD, observabilidade, on-call • Migrar/desmontar o que sobrou de Bubble pra stack code-first quando fizer sentido • Construir abstrações reutilizáveis pro próximo micro-app entrar com fricção mínima Construir time e arquitetura (escopo cresce a partir do mês 6): • Contratar a guilda de founding builders na medida em que a receita destrava • Formar e mentorar o dev pleno e os juniors que já estão no radar • Definir padrões de código, arquitetura, testing, code review, documentação • Trabalhar com o Pablo na visão técnica e com o Founding Operator na priorização de produto STACK  Code-first, AI-native, enxuto. Stack atual (e onde queremos chegar): TypeScript (Node.js, NestJS, Next.js, React) · Python (FastAPI, NLP, agentes) · PostgreSQL · vector DBs (Weaviate, ChromaDB) · OpenAI, Anthropic, LangChain · AWS, Vercel, Railway, Docker · GitHub Actions · Cursor, Claude e MCP pra programar todo dia · Stripe pra billing · Bubble (legacy, vamos migrar/desmontar conforme fizer sentido). Você não precisa ter usado tudo. Precisa ser muito confortável aprendendo rápido e operando full-stack de verdade. QUALIFICAÇÕES MÍNIMAS  • 5+ anos construindo software em produção, com pelo menos 1 produto B2B sério no histórico • Domínio de TypeScript + Python (ou conforto absoluto pra ir e vir entre os dois) • Experiência com banco relacional, APIs, auth, deploy, logs e debugging em produção • Capacidade de ir do problema de negócio ao código sem travar • Uso intenso de IA pra programar, pesquisar, documentar, testar, prototipar e automatizar • Tolerância a risco real: você topa equity-only no início em troca de equity founding-level e cargo de CTO • Capacidade de fazer deep work técnico E pensamento de arquitetura no mesmo dia, sem confundir os dois DIFERENCIAIS  • Já ter sido founding engineer ou CTO #1 de startup que atingiu PMF • Já ter operado portfolio (multi-produto, multi-stack) em estúdio, agência ou holding • Experiência com IA em produção: prompts, evals, guardrails, latência, custo, RAG, multi-agent • Experiência com migração/sunset de plataforma low-code (Bubble, Webflow) pra stack code-first • Já ter contratado, formado e liderado time de 3 a 10 engenheiros • Vontade real de virar CTO de verdade: visão, hiring, board, captação, demissão COMO MEDIMOS SUCESSO  Indicadores mudam ao longo da rampa. Ship, depois uptime, depois escala. • Ship (semanas 1-12): 5 produtos lançáveis, com infra compartilhada de billing/auth/observability operando • Uptime (mês 4+): SLA em produção, MTTR baixo, incidentes resolvidos com postmortem • Escala (mês 6+): infra suportando 10x usuários sem refatoração; novo micro-app entra com setup de poucos dias • Time: cadência de contratação alinhada com receita; mentoria efetiva do dev pleno e juniors • Ownership: você define meta técnica, executa, comunica risco cedo, entrega sem precisar ser microgerenciado CULTURA HAMURABI  Não confundimos flexibilidade com baixa intensidade. Não confundimos remoto com folga. Usamos muito IA, mas também esperamos que você saiba o que está acontecendo por baixo: cliente, dor real, produto, número, contrato, relacionamento. A gente não tem fôlego pra carregar quem não está produzindo. Quem performa tem autonomia total, equity founding-level e cargo de CTO crescendo com o estúdio. • Ownership extremo • Honestidade radical • Entrega acima de discurso • Velocidade com qualidade • Customer love acima de tudo • Multi-produto, multi-stack, multi-chapéu • IA como alavanca diária • TODO MUNDO DONO (sim, aqui todos os founding members tem equity). POTENCIAL DE GANHO  Compensação inicial é equity-only de propósito. O upside é o ponto inteiro dessa vaga. Equity: 15% founding-level, vesting 4 anos, cliff 1 ano. Em tese realizada (R$ 5M+ de ARR, múltiplos SaaS B2B 5-10x), pode atingir R$ 3,75M-7,5M. Em tese acelerada (R$ 15M+ de ARR), R$ 11M-22M. Comp. destravada por receita: • MRR R$ 30k/mês: base R$ 8k/mês PJ (~R$ 96k/ano) • MRR R$ 80k/mês: base R$ 15k/mês (R$ 180k/ano) • MRR R$ 200k/mês: base R$ 25k/mês + bônus por milestone Bônus por milestone: definido caso a caso (ship de novo micro-app, atingir SLA-alvo, escalar 10x usuários). COMO APLICAR  Lemos toda aplicação séria e damos retorno. E-mail: • Para:  • Assunto: Founding CTO - Hamurabi - Aplicacao • LinkedIn ou GitHub + texto curto se apresentando Responda também: • Por que você quer ser CTO da Hamurabi no modelo micro-apps studio? • Qual o sistema mais difícil que você já colocou em produção? Stack, escala, decisões • Como você usa IA hoje no seu trabalho de engenharia? • Olhando os 5 produtos acima, qual você abordaria primeiro tecnicamente, e por quê? • Você topa equity-only no início, com gatilhos de receita destravando comp?

title: Growth Project Manager
description:
Nova vaga disponível para Growth Project Manager em campinas. Saiba mais sobre essa oportunidade.

Localização  Remoto Tipo de Contrato  Prestação de Serviços (PJ) Sobre a vaga  Procuramos Project Manager pra coordenar a execução das contas de growth da agência. A pessoa é o motor que transforma estratégia em entrega: traduz decisão em brief, distribui pra especialistas (conteúdo, criação, dev, mídia paga, etc), garante prazo, antecipa bloqueio e mantém o cliente com a sensação de que tudo está rodando. Não é função de atendimento estratégico. Estratégia é definida pelo especialista em growth. Você é quem garante que ela vira realidade no prazo certo, com qualidade. Atendemos clientes B2B no Brasil e nos Estados Unidos, então parte da operação acontece em inglês.   O que você vai fazer no dia a dia  Traduzir decisões estratégicas (vindas de call ou clip gravado no ClickUp) em briefs claros pros especialistas Coordenar sprints quinzenais de cada cliente, do planning à entrega Cobrar prazo e qualidade dos especialistas internos sem virar atrito Manter o ClickUp como fonte única de verdade: tasks atualizadas, status correto, prazos visíveis Antecipar bloqueios e escalar pro Growth Lead antes de virar problema com cliente Participar de reuniões internas e produzir artefatos (atas com decisões e planos de ação) Cuidar de comunicação operacional com cliente (status report, follow-up de aprovação, agendamento) em português e inglês Identificar pontos de fricção no processo da agência e propor melhoria  O que você precisa ter vivido  +2 anos coordenando projetos, idealmente em agência, consultoria ou ops de startup Inglês fluente, escrito e falado. Você vai conduzir reuniões, escrever status reports e trocar mensagens com clientes nos EUA Comunicação escrita clara e objetiva em português e inglês (vamos pedir exemplo nos dois idiomas no processo seletivo) Domínio de ClickUp. Operamos 100% no ClickUp, então fluência aqui acelera muito a entrada Capacidade de cobrar prazo de pessoa mais sênior tecnicamente sem perder a mão Organização obsessiva: você é a pessoa que nunca esquece follow-up  Diferencial, mas não obrigatório  Experiência prévia em agência de marketing ou growth Vivência atendendo cliente internacional, especialmente nos EUA Familiaridade com vocabulário de growth B2B (funil, ABM, mídia paga, lifecycle) Vivência em automatização de processo (Zapier e agentes do ClickUp)  O que não esperamos  Não precisa ter experiência executando campanha, escrevendo copy ou desenhando estratégia. Esse não é o papel. Se você gosta mais de operar do que criar conteúdo de growth, é pra você. Como vamos medir seu trabalho  Entregas saindo no prazo combinado em cada sprint Tempo do Growth Lead liberado pra estratégia (você cuida da execução) Adoção e consistência dos processos da agência no ClickUp Saúde das contas que você coordena (sem cliente surpreso com atraso)  Contexto importante  Estamos em transição para um novo modelo de agência. Boa parte do processo de operação está sendo desenhada agora, e quem entrar nesse momento influencia como a agência vai funcionar daqui pra frente. Se você curte ambiente em construção e quer deixar marca no processo, vai gostar. Se prefere chegar em estrutura totalmente pronta, esse provavelmente não é o melhor momento. title: Médico Endocrinologista (RQE)
description:
Confira a oportunidade para Médico Endocrinologista (RQE) em campinas. Veja requisitos e como se candidatar.

*OPORTUNIDADE PARA MÉDICO ENDOCRINOLOGISTA (com RQE) NA TELADOC HEALTH\"  Junte-se à Nossa Equipe de Saúde Digital!  A Teladoc Health, líder global em saúde digital e inovação em cuidados de saúde, está buscando Médicas e Médicos Especialistas em Endocrinologia!  Se você é um profissional comprometido com a excelência no atendimento ao paciente e deseja fazer parte de uma revolução na prestação de serviços de saúde, esta é a oportunidade que você estava esperando. *SOBRE A TELADOC HEALTH: * A Teladoc Health está na vanguarda da transformação da saúde, oferecendo acesso rápido, conveniente e confiável a serviços de saúde através de nossa plataforma digital. Nossa missão é tornar o cuidado de saúde acessível a todos, em qualquer lugar e a qualquer momento. Combinando tecnologia de ponta e conhecimento médico, estamos moldando o futuro da saúde e proporcionando impacto positivo na vida de milhões de pessoas. *O QUE PROCURAMOS: * Você será responsável por realizar consultas por vídeo e telefone, por intermédio de plataforma do empregador, atendendo na modalidade de consultas de especialidade em Endocrinologia , de forma ética, com abordagem biopsicossocial do processo saúde-adoecimento, integrando ações de prevenção, promoção, proteção, recuperação e educação em saúde buscando alcançar os melhores resultados clínicos; DESCRIÇÃO DAS ATIVIDADES:  Fornecer atendimento médico especializado em Endocrinologia  de forma remota, através de consultas e avaliações realizadas por meio de plataformas digitais de comunicação.  Experiência e conhecimento para o diagnóstico, tratamento e acompanhamento de pacientes com doenças e distúrbios Endocrinológicos .  Realizar consultas em Telemedicina sendo capaz de conduzir anamnese virtual para coletar queixas e histórico médico, realizar exame clínico e avaliações à distância, interpretar resultados de exames laboratoriais e de imagem, elaborar diagnósticos precisos, propor medidas terapêuticas e orientações de cuidado, reconhecer sinais de risco e gravidade em Endocrinologia  e critérios para encaminhar ao atendimento presencial.  Atuar de forma a priorizar a prática médica centrada na pessoa.  Elaborar planos de tratamento individualizados, levando em consideração as necessidades específicas de cada paciente.  Ser hábil na prescrição de medicamentos adequados para tratar doenças Endocrinológicas .  Monitorar o progresso dos pacientes ao longo do tratamento em telemedicina.  Realizar ajustes no plano de tratamento, conforme necessário, com base na resposta do paciente ao tratamento.  Desenvolver atividades integrais de saúde, incorporando prevenção e promoção de saúde para dar as respostas mais adequadas às necessidades de saúde apresentadas.  Atender com elevado grau de qualidade, sendo resolutivo na grande maioria das orientações acerca dos principais problemas de saúde em Endocrinologia.   Considerar os valores e preferências pessoais do paciente conjuntamente às melhores evidências científicas e à experiência de manejo clínico para efetivamente promover a melhor prática clínica e os melhores desfechos em saúde para cada indivíduo.  Exercer uso racional de recursos em saúde visando a segurança do paciente e a prevenção quaternária, evitando sobrediagnóstico e sobretratamento, que expõe os indivíduos a maiores riscos do que benefícios em saúde.  Estimular a participação e a autonomia dos indivíduos e familiares, fortalecendo a aderência a tratamentos e medidas de autocuidado.  Documentar todas as interações e informações relevantes dos pacientes em prontuários eletrônicos seguros e confidenciais.  Ter capacidade de crítica de sua própria atividade médica, considerando-a em seus aspectos científicos, éticos e sociais para aprimoramento contínuo.  Manter-se bem-informado e atualizado, ampliando sua própria competência em relação a conhecimentos sobre riscos em saúde e sobre as medidas mais eficientes para eliminar ou reduzir os riscos relevantes.  Respeitar, cumprir e fazer cumprir os ditames do Código de Ética Médica, bem como a Legislação vigente e os regulamentos internos formais da Instituição.  REQUISITOS   Formação Acadêmica:   Obrigatório: GRADUAÇÃO EM MEDICINA RESIDÊNCIA MÉDICA OU ESPECIALIZAÇÃO EM ENDOCRINOLOGIA.   Certificações:   Registro ativo no Conselho Regional de Medicina (CRM); Certificado de Título de Especialista - RQE (emitido pelo Conselho respectivo) em Endocrinologia.  Certificado Digital Ativo reconhecido pela Infraestrutura de Chaves Públicas Brasileira (ICP-Brasil).  Experiência:   Experiência em atividades relacionadas à atuação em atendimento médico em Endocrinologia , sendo desejável experiência prévia em Telemedicina e Atenção Primária à Saúde; Conhecimentos Específicos para a função:   Prestar orientações personalizadas a indivíduos e suas famílias com conhecimentos para o diagnóstico, tratamento e acompanhamento de pacientes com doenças e distúrbios Endócrinos e metabólicos..  Competências Comportamentais:  Comprometimento com os pacientes, com ideais e valores da empresa, apresentando postura ética, pontualidade, capacidade de integração com equipe multiprofissional. Outros Requisitos Importantes:   Conhecimentos e Habilidades em computação: uso do Pacote Office (Excel, Word, Power Point, Gráficos) e Internet. Familiaridade com tecnologias de telemedicina e uso de plataformas de comunicação virtual é um diferencial desejável. Local de Trabalho:  REMOTO IMPORTANTE:  MODELO DE CONTRATAÇÃO:  Contratação em regime de Prestador de Serviços por contrato Pessoa Jurídica, necessário fazer parte como representante legal ou sócio de um CNPJ ativo. REMUNERAÇÃO E AGENDAMENTOS : a negociar durante processo seletivo. Esta descrição de cargo/atuação tem caráter informativo e pode ser ajustada conforme a necessidade da empresa ou instituição que oferece a oportunidade de trabalho em telemedicina para Médico Clínico/Generalista Residente em Endocrinologia.

title: Engenheiro de IA Generativa - Especialista
description:
Confira a oportunidade para Engenheiro de IA Generativa - Especialista em campinas. Veja requisitos e como se candidatar.

Descrição da vaga  Buscamos uma pessoa Especialista em IA Generativa , com forte domínio técnico e capacidade de influenciar decisões arquiteturais e estratégicas. Essa posição atua de forma transversal, apoiando a evolução da plataforma de LLMOps e a entrega de soluções de alto impacto para o negócio. Construção e evolução de soluções de IA Generativa que suportam jornadas críticas do banco, integrando modelos, dados e plataformas com alto padrão de engenharia. Foco está em escalar o uso de LLMs de forma segura, governada e sustentável, apoiando produtos, operações e áreas internas. title: Principal SQL Server Engineer
description:

Monthly salary:  $5,500 - $7,000 USD Along with our partner, we’re looking for a Principal Database Engineer who can serve as the technical leader for our SQL Server–focused engineering team. This person should be the team’s strongest expert in SQL Server development, performance engineering, and operational reliability — and equally strong in designing data‐centric solutions that balance correctness, performance, maintainability, and business constraints. The ideal candidate brings deep, hands‐on mastery of SQL Server internals and can connect engine behavior to real‐world workload patterns. They should be able to diagnose, design, enhance, and optimize database solutions at scale, and guide others in doing the same. You will collaborate with engineering, product, and business stakeholders to ensure requirements are well‐understood, technically feasible, and aligned with long‐term architectural goals. Essential Duties:  Database Design and Development:  Guide the evolution and improvement of database architecture, design and implementations. Apply expert‐level understanding of relational modeling, T‐SQL, indexing strategies, and SQL Server engine behavior to build systems that scale and perform under real‐world workloads. Performance Monitoring and Optimization:  Continuously assess system performance at both the instance and query level. Diagnose and remediate issues, including those involving poor execution plans, parameter sniffing, bad cardinality estimation, SARGability obstacles, inadequate or incorrect indexing, and concurrency issues involving locking, blocking, and/or deadlocks. Engineering Solution Design:  Break down complex data and workload problems, identify multiple viable solution paths, and evaluate them against functional and non‐functional requirements. Clearly articulate tradeoffs, recommend, and justify the best approach. Collaboration with Development Teams:  Partner closely with application and service teams to ensure database designs support application behavior, performance goals, and operational constraints. Provide guidance on query patterns, schema usage, and integration with .NET and cloud services. Incident Management:  Lead the response to database‐related incidents. Perform root‐cause analysis, implement durable fixes, and improve observability, alerting, and operational readiness. Mentorship and Training:  Coach and mentor database engineers and developers. Establish and promote best practices in SQL development, performance tuning, and operational excellence. Data Security Management:  Contribute to the implementation and enforcement of security controls, ensuring protection of sensitive data and compliance with relevant standards. Backup, Recovery, and Reliability Engineering:  Contribute to the design and management of resilient backup, restore, and disaster‐recovery processes. Help ensure systems are prepared for failure scenarios and can recover predictably.  Minimum Qualifications:  Education: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, or a related discipline. Experience: 10+ years in database engineering, data management, or database administration, with significant hands‐on experience in SQL Server. Technical Skills: Deep expertise in SQL Server development, performance tuning, and engine internals. Strong understanding of indexing, execution plans, statistics, concurrency, and workload behavior. Experience with cloud platforms (Azure preferred), including managed SQL services and related data technologies. Proficiency in T‐SQL; familiarity with C#/.NET services is a plus.  Key Competencies:  Database Design and Architecture:  Ability to design scalable, efficient SQL Server solutions in cloud environments, with strong judgment around schema design, indexing, and workload patterns. Performance Tuning and Optimization:  Expertise in diagnosing and resolving performance issues at all layers of the SQL Server stack. Cloud Technologies:  Experience with cloud‐based database services (Azure SQL, Managed Instance, AWS RDS, etc.) and understanding of how cloud infrastructure impacts database design and performance. Programming and Engineering Skills:  Strong T‐SQL development skills and familiarity with the broader SQL Server ecosystem. Ability to reason about system‐level design and integrate database solutions with application architectures. Data Management and Security:  Ensure data integrity, enforce security controls, and resolve data‐related issues with precision and accountability. Leadership and Collaboration:  Provide technical leadership, mentor team members, and communicate clearly with cross‐functional partners. Influence architectural direction and foster a culture of engineering excellence.  Benefits:  A fully remote position with a structured schedule that supports work-life balance. The opportunity to lead and optimize large-scale data systems that power critical business operations. Two weeks of paid vacation per year. 10 paid days for local holidays.  *Please note our partner is only looking for full-time dedicated team members who are eager to fully integrate within their team.

Trabalhar em parceria com os times de produto e engenharia para garantir boas práticas de modelagem e performance. Atuar na observabilidade e rastreabilidade  dos dados em ambientes SQL e NoSQL. Participar da definição de padrões e políticas de governança de dados dentro da arquitetura Data Mesh. Realizar troubleshooting e tuning de queries e estruturas de dados. Requisitos Técnicos:  Experiência avançada com SQL Server , PostgreSQL  e MongoDB . Domínio de AWS , especialmente em serviços voltados para bancos de dados e infraestrutura. Conhecimento em infraestrutura como código (IaC)  com Terraform ou CloudFormation . Automação com PowerShell, Bash ou Python . Experiência com ferramentas de monitoramento e observabilidade  (ex: Prometheus, Grafana, ELK). Familiaridade com arquitetura orientada a domínios (DDD)  e Data Mesh . Conhecimento em CI/CD  e integração com pipelines de dados. Experiência com ambientes cloud-native  e containers (Docker, Kubernetes) .  O que você encontra aqui:  Remote First  – Acreditamos no trabalho remoto como um estilo de vida. Nossas vagas são 100% remotas, mas caso queira trabalhar no nosso escritório em Porto Alegre/RS - é só chegar. Comunidades Técnicas  – Um espaço para galera trocar uma ideia, conversar sobre algum assunto específico e, claro, muita troca de conhecimentos. Cultura de Feedback  – Feedbacks estruturados periodicamente, buscando o desenvolvimento contínuo através de um Plano de Desenvolvimento Individual (PDI). Horário Flexível  - Autonomia para fazer a sua própria gestão da jornada de trabalho. Incentivo ao Idioma  - Temos como objetivo internacionalizar cada vez mais a Vortigo e você será parte disso! Wellhub  - Plataforma focada na saúde e bem-estar corporativo. Reembolso de Equipamentos  – Valor semestral de reembolso para compra de equipamentos que facilitam sua rotina de trabalho em casa.

Senior Backend Engineer  Hitch — Remote About Hitch  Hitch is a white-label specialty lending platform powering Non-QM mortgage products (HELOC, DSCR, HEI) and AI-native origination tools for leading non-bank lenders. We sit between borrowers, lenders, and the systems that move money — Encompass, credit bureaus, AVM vendors, pricing engines, payroll, and banking infrastructure. We treat configuration as a product: one codebase across all clients, dynamic fields, function-based roles. Backend engineers here own real surface area. What You'll Do  Design and build services that power loan origination workflows end-to-end — from soft credit pull through pricing, underwriting automation, disclosure delivery, and offer acceptance. We treat vendor APIs as a first-class engineering concern — retries, idempotency, outage handling, and webhook reconciliation are part of the job. Architect multi-tenant, configuration-driven systems. Every feature should generalize across white-label clients without forking code. Build and operate background jobs and async pipelines (BullMQ) — webhook processing, credit pulls, document generation, SLA monitoring. Set the standard on code quality, testing, and observability. Mentor mid-level engineers and contribute to architecture reviews. Partner with PM and AI teams on shipping AI-assisted features that require reliable, auditable data infrastructure underneath.  What You Bring  6+ years building production backend systems in TypeScript/Node.js. Deep experience with Node.js: async patterns, event loop, performance considerations, runtime behavior. Strong relational or document database design — we use MongoDB with Prisma; you should reason confidently about schema design, indexing, and consistency tradeoffs. Hands-on experience with async/queue-based architectures (BullMQ, SQS, Kafka, or equivalent). A track record of reliable third-party integrations: retry strategies, idempotency, vendor outage handling, webhook reconciliation. Comfort operating in compliance-sensitive environments (SOC 2, lending regulations, audit trails). You don't need to be a TRID expert on day one — but you ask \"what happens if this fails halfway through?\" Strong written communication for async collaboration across time zones (PRs, design docs, Linear tickets).  Nice to Have  Experience with tRPC or similar typed API contract patterns. Prior work in mortgage, fintech, lending, or another regulated vertical. Encompass / ICE Mortgage Technology API experience. Experience with multi-tenant SaaS or white-label platforms. Familiarity with Next.js (we use it for server-side API layers, not UI development in this role). Working knowledge of Redis, Zod, BullMQ, Prisma.  Our Backend Stack  TypeScript · Node.js · tRPC · Prisma · MongoDB · Redis · BullMQ · Zod · Docker · AWS S3 · Render · Datadog · Jest · GitHub Actions

description:

Location: Brazil (100% Remote) Experience Level: Mid to Senior (5+ years) Industry: Oil & Gas (Unconventional Onshore) Role Summary  We are seeking a highly analytical Senior Regulatory & Severance Tax Accountant to join our integrated Revenue team. The primary focus of this role is to ensure the integrity of severance tax reporting for Texas and Louisiana operations. You will be responsible for identifying, troubleshooting, and resolving reporting discrepancies that lead to state-issued penalties. This is a technical, hands-on role requiring deep experience in SAP PRA (CA/VL modules) and the ability to bridge the gap between transactional data and state regulatory compliance. Responsibilities  Severance Tax Compliance : Lead the end-to-end severance tax reporting process for Texas and Louisiana, ensuring all volumes and values are reported accurately and timely to the respective state agencies. Error Detection & Troubleshooting : Proactively identify reporting errors by comparing state-level data against internal production and valuation records. Utilize the Valuation Control Report (VCR) and specific SAP T-Codes to diagnose root causes of variances. PPA Analysis : Analyze Prior Period Adjustments (PPAs) before posting to understand the ripple effect on the General Ledger (GL), production volumes, and pricing. Ensure all adjustments are justified and accurately reflected in amended filings. Penalty Reduction : Serve as the lead in reducing state-issued penalties through meticulous data validation and the timely filing of amended returns (e.g., Texas G-10/P-5, Louisiana O3). Process Improvement : Troubleshoot systemic process failures and, as needed, document standardized workflows to serve as guides for broader transactional teams. Cross-Functional Collaboration : Work as one team with the Revenue Accounting group to ensure that valuation formulas and owner payment setups are consistent with regulatory requirements.  Requirements  Minimum of 2 years of hands-on experience in the Check Input (CA) and Valuation (VL) modules. Must have experience booking company-operated revenues and navigating sub-ledger details. At least 5+ years of experience, including experience in Upstream Oil & Gas accounting, ideally focused on unconventional, onshore assets. Proven experience with US (ideally Texas and Louisiana )severance tax regulations, including high-cost gas exemptions and state disposition reporting. Ability to perform deep-dive reconciliations across production, revenue, and tax data sets to identify complex transactional errors. Advanced/Fluent English (written and spoken) is required for coordination with US-based stakeholders. A diagnostic mindset - able to look at a reporting error and trace the logic back through the SAP PRA system to the source data. Capable of managing complex reporting deadlines and independent research in a fully remote environment.  Technical Requirements  ERP:  SAP PRA (CA, VL modules), S/4HANA (preferred). Reporting Tools:  Advanced Excel (Power Query/Pivot), Power BI, VCR Analysis.

title: Liquidity Partnership Manager (LATAM)
description:
Nova vaga disponível para Liquidity Partnership Manager (LATAM) em campinas. Saiba mais sobre essa oportunidade.

Role Overview  We are looking for an LP Partnership Manager to drive business development and build strong relationships with liquidity providers across key regions. This role will be instrumental in sourcing, onboarding, and managing LP partners, while working closely with the trading team to optimize liquidity, pricing, and execution. The ideal candidate is highly connected within the local market, with a strong network of liquidity providers and a deep understanding of regional payment and banking landscapes. Key Responsibilities  Business Development & Partnerships  Identify, source, and establish relationships with local and regional liquidity providers Evaluate LP quality (pricing, depth, reliability, regions covered) Negotiate trading terms (spreads, fees, credit lines, margin terms)  Market & Network Development  Leverage existing network to expand LP coverage in key regions (APAC, LATAM, Africa) Maintain strong relationships with banks, payment providers, and liquidity partners Stay up to date with local market dynamics, pricing trends, and competitive landscape  Execution & Collaboration  Work closely with traders to ensure optimal liquidity, pricing, and execution quality Coordinate with internal teams to onboard LPs and ensure smooth operational setup Support ongoing performance monitoring and optimization of LP relationships  Banking & Infrastructure Setup  Facilitate opening of bank accounts and payment rails required for LP operations Identify suitable partners to support local currency flows and settlement  Requirements  5 to 10 years of experience in business development, partnerships, or liquidity management Strong experience in payments, FX, trading, or related financial services Well connected with liquidity providers, banks, and payment partners Proven ability to source and onboard LPs in local markets Strong understanding of regional market structures and liquidity dynamics Must have strong, deep LP network in at least one of the following regions: LATAM   Vision & Mission  OSL is the first SFC-licensed digital asset platform in Hong Kong and a PayFi innovator. Through stablecoin payments, cross-border settlement and global licensing, we are building the next-generation payments network. Stablecoins have become everyday money across emerging markets and are widely viewed as blockchain’s “killer app,” with industry focus shifting from token issuance to real-world consumer and enterprise payment adoption. The strongest growth lies in cross-border B2B payments, where providers embedding stablecoins into corporate settlement flows can capture significant volume and float. Long-term defensibility comes from regulatory licences, banking partners and cross-border corridors. OSL holds or has acquired licences in Hong Kong, Japan, Australia, Bermuda and Indonesia, and is expanding into Europe, Brazil, Southeast Asia and Africa through acquisitions and licence applications. With OSL Pay and StableX, we embed stablecoin settlement into bank accounts and card networks, support 150+ digital assets, and provide 24/7 fiat–stablecoin conversion. As a regulated pioneer with a startup mindset, we believe the future of payments will be driven by real adoption and scalable deployment, not technology narratives. We welcome builders who are passionate about crypto and payments to join us in shaping compliant, global payment infrastructure.

Conhecimento de Lucro Real, Lucro Presumido e Simples Nacional . Domínio do Pacote Office  (principalmente Excel ). Sistema Domínio : conhecimento prático e comprovado  (eliminatório). Organização, atenção a detalhes, senso de dono e comunicação clara em ambiente remoto.  Nossa cultura  Aqui, trabalho é esforço, resultado e entrega . Valorizamos profissionais que desejam ter direitos respeitados , mas que também entendem que nossa empresa preza por meritocracia e comprometimento . Não seguimos a chamada “cultura do mimimi”. Acreditamos em um ambiente justo, com reconhecimento proporcional ao desempenho , onde quem se dedica, cresce. Benefícios  Vaga 100% remota  — Acreditamos de verdade no Home Office. Mas com monitoramento de performance  por metas e entregas claras. Utilizamos um programa chamado Jibble, para controle de trabalho remoto. Gestão humanizada  — Valorizamos a diversidade e quem você é  ️‍ . Para nós humanização começa com quem está aqui dentro. Day-off no aniversário  — Aproveite seu dia para comemorar. Feedbacks trimestrais estruturados  através do nosso Comitê de Pessoas  — Significa que você tem chance real de ser promovido a cada 3 meses , conforme seu desempenho. Disponibilizamos para você e 3 familiares pago 100% pela nossa empresa. Treinamento e desenvolvimento  — Investimos no seu crescimento com cursos pagos pela empresa. Adicional  no salário caso utilize equipamentos próprios  para trabalho remoto — Afinal respeitamos seus equipamentos próprios e vamos te pagar pela utilização dos mesmos, caso necessário.  Como se candidatar  Candidate-se pelo LinkedIn e mantenha seu currículo atualizado , mandatóriamente em PDF. É obrigatório que o número do CRC ativo  conste no currículo para validação. Caso possua, anexe certificações  e destaque projetos/rotinas relevantes (fechamento contábil, ECD/ECF, apuração de tributos, acompanhamento de legislação e uso do Sistema Domínio). Nosso processo seletivo será feito em 4 fases com previsão de contratação ainda neste mês de Abril/26.  Venha construir sua carreira com a gente e fazer parte de um time que está transformando o futuro da contabilidade e das empresas!

title: Electrical Engineering Pod Lead - 72132
description:
Confira a oportunidade para Electrical Engineering Pod Lead - 72132 em campinas. Veja requisitos e como se candidatar.

About Turing:  Based in San Francisco, California, Turing is the world’s leading research accelerator for frontier AI labs and a trusted partner for global enterprises deploying advanced AI systems. Turing supports customers in two ways: first, by accelerating frontier research with high-quality data, advanced training pipelines, plus top AI researchers who specialize in coding, reasoning, STEM, multilinguality, multimodality, and agents; and second, by applying that expertise to help enterprises transform AI from proof of concept into proprietary intelligence with systems that perform reliably, deliver measurable impact, and drive lasting results on the P&L Job Overview:  An Electrical Engineering Pod Lead  responsible for managing a small team creating simulation-based design problems  used to train and evaluate advanced AI models. The role owns problem quality, reproducible environments, and coordination with AI researchers , and requires strong EE domain depth plus hands-on Python, Docker, and basic cloud  skills to review and support the pod end-to-end. Key Responsibilities:  Team Leadership Lead and manage a pod of 4–8 Engineering Design Specialists by assigning tasks, reviewing deliverables, removing blockers, and mentoring on problem design, simulation rigor, and documentation. Act as the main point of contact with AI research teams to translate model feedback into refinements, while running regular syncs, tracking progress, and reporting updates and risks to program leads. Technical Oversight Oversee and approve pod outputs, maintain reproducible Docker-based simulation environments, support cloud infrastructure for simulation/grading, Develop and review Python automation/validation, and proactively resolve dependency, versioning, and reproducibility issues. Problem Design (Individual Contribution) Personally design a portfolio of high-difficulty electrical engineering problems in your chosen subdomain. Set the quality bar and design philosophy for the pod through your own example submissions.  Electrical Engineering Subdomains:  You must have deep expertise in at least one of the following, with working familiarity across others being a strong plus: Analog / Mixed-Signal IC Design — op-amp topologies, ADC/DAC design, noise analysis, layout-aware design, SPICE-level simulation. Power Electronics — DC-DC converters, inverter design, magnetics sizing, thermal management, efficiency optimization. RF / Microwave Engineering — filter design, impedance matching, S-parameter analysis, transmission line and antenna design. Digital Systems / FPGA / ASIC — RTL design, timing closure, synthesis-aware design, hardware-software co-design. Embedded Systems — microcontroller/DSP-based design, real-time constraints, peripheral interfacing, power budgeting.  Required Qualifications:  Master's degree or PhD in Electrical Engineering or a closely related discipline. At least 5 years of hands-on electrical engineering design experience, with a track record of owning designs from specification through validated implementation. At least 1–2 years of experience in a technical lead, senior engineer, or team coordination role. Proficiency with Python for scripting, automation, and simulation workflows. Hands-on experience with Docker: building images, writing Dockerfiles, managing containerized environments. Familiarity with at least one cloud platform (AWS, GCP, or Azure) — comfortable running workloads, managing storage, and monitoring jobs. Proficiency with at least one open-source EE simulation tool (e.g., ngspice, PySpice, Qucs, OpenEMS, scikit-rf, or similar).  Nice-to-Have:  Experience designing engineering coursework, exam problems, or design challenges at graduate level. Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines or automated testing frameworks. Exposure to LLM evaluation, AI benchmarking, or training data curation. Cross-domain familiarity with Control Systems, Embedded/Robotics, or Power Systems.  Evaluation Process:  Shortlisted candidates will be sent a Job Interest Form . Shortlisted candidates will receive a Job Interest Form . After the initial profile review, we will share an assessment , which must be completed within 24 hours . Based on the assessment submission and your responses, we may schedule an interview round . Based on the assessment outcomes, shortlisted candidates will be contacted to discuss the pre‑onboarding requirements .  After applying, you will receive an email with a login link. Please use that link to access the portal and complete your profile.  Know amazing talent? Refer them at turing.com/referrals, and earn money from your network.
